defects.justification: POST /login (and /signup, /invites/accept) has no rate limiting, attempt counting or lockout, so passwords can be brute-forced online without limit; the README admits this instead of fixing it.

golang.org/x/crypto v0.28.0 is older than the fixes for the published x/crypto/ssh advisories (CVE-2024-45337, fixed in v0.31.0; CVE-2025-22869, fixed in v0.35.0). Only bcrypt is used here, so the risk is low, but the pin should be raised.
